correctness.rationale: The cross-side color lemma follows immediately from crown adjacency. The four-color construction gives a surviving singleton neighbor color for every vertex, and the four cases for zero, one, two, or three shared colors exclude every coloring with at most three colors when n>=4. The n=2 and n=3 cases are direct. Exhaustive replay confirms the boundary cases.

originality.rationale: Targeted current-literature and published-finding corpus searches for crown graphs, K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching, deleted-matchings, and PCF synonyms found foundational, complexity, and general-bound work but no equivalent or stronger exact crown formula. This is a best-of-knowledge assessment and not a proof of novelty.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a closed exact value on an infinite classical dense bipartite family of unbounded degree and supplies a reusable lemma describing every cross-side color class in crown graphs.
